MeetingPlbkStageContentDoc.name: MeetingPlbkStageContentDoc
MeetingPlbkStageContentDoc.description: Represents a document attached to a meeting playbook. It stores meeting-specific details, such as applicable stages and an AI-generated summary.

ContentDocumentId.description: Stores a document that has been uploaded to a library in Salesforce CRM Content or Salesforce Files.

DocumentType.description: Represents the type of file being uploaded or attached.

ExtractedText.description: Stores the plain text extracted from a document.

IsGenerateAiSummary.description: Indicates whether to generate an AI summary of the document.

IsIncludeInClientPacket.description: Indicates whether to include this document in the client packet.

IsIncludeInMeetingBrief.description: Indicates whether to include this document in the meeting brief, making it available to view in all stages.

IsMeetingNotes.description: Indicates whether this document represents the meeting notes for the playbook stage.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user viewed this record.

MeetingPlaybookId.description: Stores a meeting playbook created from a meeting playbook definition.

MeetingPlaybookStageId.description: Represents a stage in a meeting playbook, created from a meeting playbook definition stage.

Name.description: An automatically generated name for this meeting playbook stage content document.
